name: VerbaSync
problem: A multilingual publication can silently change prohibitions, quantities or conditions across languages and leave subscribers using withdrawn wording.
core_concept: Atomic multilingual release bundles with segment-level independent semantic equivalence, exact editor approvals, immutable version vectors, consumer acknowledgements and divergence-triggered release freezes.

genlayer_intelligence.primary_role: Independently interpret translated segments against canonical source segments, distinguishing equivalent, divergent and uncertain meaning.
state_effects: freeze a live release after a substantiated divergence
qualify a corrected segment under a new immutable version

protocol_mechanisms: translation attempts bound to exact source hash
economic_model: No escrow, payments, rewards or token. Exact multilingual edition adoption and subscriber synchronization coordinate publication.

scope_exceptions.frontend: Persistent user contracts-only scope overrides frontend, visual reservation and browser/dashboard requirements. No styles or skeletons consumed.

novelty_comparison.rejected: Heritage provenance resembles auction provenance; remediation and dispatch resemble Civic Pulse; software migration resembles Dependency Sentinel.
novelty_comparison.distinction: No security dependency graph or mitigation permits, research quorum or experimental cohorts, circular material clearing, bilateral redlining, data-use licenses, funds or reputation. Semantic locale matrices drive atomic edition activation and subscriber adoption.

readme_fingerprint.opening_device: A source/translation meaning mismatch shown as an editor desk incident.
readme_fingerprint.editorial_voice: Localization release engineer explaining exact publication barriers.
readme_fingerprint.document_architecture: Mismatch example, version vector anatomy, editor workflow, subscriber handoff, freeze/replacement, reproducible verification and authority limits.
readme_fingerprint.diagram_language: Locale-by-segment matrix and atomic edition version vector.
readme_fingerprint.proof_and_verification_style: Every readiness predicate paired with executable refusal and successor adoption evidence.
readme_fingerprint.section_sequence: Meaning inversion, locale matrix, editor execution, consensus constraints, subscriber handoff, issue suspension, method families, operational bounds, reproduction, responsibility transfer.
readme_fingerprint.heading_style: Workplace release desk vocabulary rather than numbered plates, experiment timelines or conservation equations.
readme_fingerprint.table_strategy: Bilingual meaning contrast, issue-effect table, authority families and environment names.
readme_fingerprint.technical_depth_pattern: Each actor workflow is followed by the exact immutable vector and state predicates it can change.
